# Culture of Extensions by Lana
> Where modern goddesses are born — The Pinnacle of Luxury Hair Extensions in Los Angeles & Burbank

Culture of Extensions by Lana is an ultra-luxury, private bespoke hair extension studio founded by master specialist Lana (Svitlana Levenets, 14+ years experience, 2,500+ transformations) located at 2119 N Glenoaks Blvd, Burbank, CA 91504, serving Burbank, Beverly Hills, Glendale, Studio City, Toluca Lake, Pasadena, and Greater Los Angeles.

## Core Services & Specialties
- **Signature K-Tip Micro-Capsule Extensions**: Ultra-nano Italian keratin bonds placed strand-by-strand with 360-degree natural mobility and zero scalp damage. Perfect for fine hair and sleek high ponytails. (From $700, full Slavic transformations $1,500–$3,500).
- **BIO Tape & Color Extensions**: Ultra-thin skin-weft tape-ins engineered for seamless flat-laying profiles and damage-free wear. (From $500).
- **Volume & Density Work**: Targeted row and micro-capsule placement designed for thinning temples, crown areas, or post-breakage recovery. (From $400).
- **Full Length Transformations**: Bespoke 18" to 28" virgin Slavic transformations with multi-tonal root matching. (From $1,000).
- **Cult Academy**: Master-level certification courses in micro-capsulation and tension biomechanics for licensed stylists.

## Philosophy & Differentiators
- **100% Authentic Raw Virgin Slavic & European Remy Hair**: Ethically sourced single-donor bundles with intact, unidirectional cuticles. Never acid-stripped or silicone-coated. Lasts 12 to 24 months with move-ups.
- **Zero-Damage Biomechanics**: Proprietary tension-free sectioning and 1:1 strand weight matching that protects biological follicular health and prevents traction alopecia.
- **Private Studio Sanctuary**: One client at a time in Burbank. Unhurried, confidential, bespoke artistry. Consultations available in English, Spanish, and Russian (EN / ES / RU).
